Elias read it twice, then climbed back up and lit the lamp an hour early, in case someone out there was still counting on it.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还在半梦半醒之间。写字楼的灯只剩零星几盏，像海上未熄的星。环卫车的声音从街角传来，扫帚划过路面，一下，又一下。便利店的灯光白得发亮，值夜班的店员靠着收银台打盹。街灯下，一只流浪猫慢慢穿过空荡的斑马线，影子被拉得很长。早点铺的蒸笼开始冒热气，白雾升起，混着豆浆的甜香。两小时后，这座城市会彻底醒来；而此刻，它只属于清洁工、流浪猫，和失眠的人。", "w03": "• Imagine standing in a line of elephants, each holding the tail of the elephant in front, and you want to count how many there are.\n• Each elephant asks the one ahead, 'How many are in front of you?' and that same little question travels up the line until it reaches the first elephant.\n• The first elephant answers 'just me—one,' and the answer travels back with each elephant adding one; asking a tinier version of the same question until it's easy is recursion."}
